text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! Morning runs are the best!
Soaking in the sunrise while stretching—
ready to take on the day☆

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Guh, dammit!
I gotta push off, harder, harder against the ground!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, girl... Hey!
Wait a second! Stoooop for a bit!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, nice! That feels easier to run in, right?
Keep that up and try jogging a bit☆

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
You're right, I'm making way more headway than before!
Um, thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Also, I'm sorry...
for being so startled when you called out to me.
I thought you were going to give me feng shui advice...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Feng shui isn't shady at all, though.
Well, I'll save that advice for later!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Actually, the one who taught me how to run like this is my Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: The only reason I could give advice just now was because you taught me with clear words and practical demonstrations.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure!?
Teaching someone like me something so important...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "Hmm, I want to pass forward what I've learned. That way, everyone ends up happy, right?"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Plus, by outputting the material, I can
reinforce my own learning through repetition!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, hey, want to run together?
I'm feeling really pumped up right now!
